name: The Valor Family
summary: Sirra Von'Indi asks you to search Raven Hill for records of its lost people. Darkshire remembers their courage, but little of Raven Hill's history remains in her library.

sections.title: A Lost History
sections.body: Sirra Von'Indi says Darkshire owes its survival to brave people, including Lady Althea and those who died at Raven Hill. You are asked to look for anything that can preserve their memory.

sections.title: The Tome
sections.body: The book you bring back concerns the Valor family. Sirra offers to copy it and welcomes other material about them.

faq.q: Who is asking me to search Raven Hill?
faq.answer: Sirra Von'Indi, whose library is in Darkshire, asks you to look for material about Raven Hill.

faq.q: Why does Sirra want records from Raven Hill?
faq.answer: Sirra says Raven Hill's history was lost along with its people, and she wants their deeds remembered.

faq.q: Who does Sirra say helped keep Darkshire standing?
faq.answer: Sirra names Lady Althea and those who lost their lives at Raven Hill as brave people whose actions helped Darkshire endure.

faq.q: What is Raven Hill's history like?
faq.answer: Sirra says Raven Hill's history was wiped out along with its people, and her library holds little about it.

attribution: In-game quest text: The Valor Family
